brief: Use case: illustration-story. Standalone transparent watercolor cutout for Pink Lido birthday invitation. Reference concept for object design; existing pink swim ring and yellow parasol for soft watercolor/gouache style, imperfect wash brush marks, textured paper within painted areas, bright colors, handmade edges, simple forms. One complete centered object, 10% transparent margin, no props, text, emoji or ground plane.

subjects.swimsuit: Cheerful one-piece swimsuit, yellow and warm ivory vertical stripes, two shoulder straps, front view flat lay, slightly tilted.
subjects.sunglasses: Pink coral cat-eye sunglasses, dark plum lenses, front three-quarter flat lay view.
subjects.hat: Summer straw sunhat, wide rounded brim, golden straw, broad pink ribbon with a bow, angled top-down three-quarter view.
